runtime: ISO C++ standard library (WG21 working draft source, checked 2026-11-12)

official_documentation_checked.api: C++ standard library headers, library introduction
official_documentation_checked.finding: The listed standard library components do not define a RIFF/WAVE chunk or PCM reader.
std::ifstream reads generic file bytes; it does not interpret WAV chunks, sample rates or PCM frames.

limit: Scoped to the ISO C++ standard library. Platform audio frameworks and third-party C libraries usable from C++ are inventoried separately. No standard WAV-aware API was documented to run.
